headerDisplay: Controls a NAD BluOS amplifier (e.g. M33) from Apple Home. Requires an MQTT broker that bridges the amplifier's power/volume/source topics - see the plugin README. The amplifier is found on the network automatically, but is only added to HomeKit once its MAC address has been added below.

id.title: Device ID
id.description: Used as the MQTT topic segment for this device, e.g. "m33" for cmd/m33/volume. Not readable from the amplifier - choose your own.

macaddress.title: MAC Address
macaddress.description: Matches this entry to the amplifier found on the network. Find it on the amplifier's own settings page, or in the BluOS app.

name.title: Display Name
name.description: Shown in the Home app. Defaults to "NAD <model>".

volumeCap.title: Maximum Volume
volumeCap.description: The highest value ever written to the volume topic, and what 100% maps to in the Home app.

minVolume.title: Minimum Volume
minVolume.description: The lowest value ever written to the volume topic, and what 0% (and muting) map to.

streamSourcePosition.title: BluOS Streaming Source Position
streamSourcePosition.description: The integer written to the source topic to leave a physical input and return to normal BluOS/streaming playback. Verify against your unit if input switching seems wrong.

mqtt.title: MQTT Broker
mqtt.description: Required - this plugin is controlled entirely through MQTT, not through the amplifier's own HTTP interface.

payloads.title: Power Payloads
payloads.description: Only change these if your MQTT bridge expects something other than "1"/"0" for power on/off.

discoveryIntervalMinutes.title: Network Re-scan Interval (minutes)
discoveryIntervalMinutes.description: How often to re-check the network for configured amplifiers - handles a changed IP address or a device that was offline at startup. Set to 0 to disable.
